name: English Developer Textpack
description: Generated English developer recipe composite over the current English component graph with local KB, corpus, and parallel payloads.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over the currently generated English foundation, core, normalization, segmentation, lexicon, morphology, syntax, KB, search, corpus, parallel, and quality component graph. Required KB, corpus, and parallel components now provide local task-usable payloads for their declared scopes.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Required component source rows are approved and default-composite compatible: IANA, Unicode, CLDR, ESDB, SCOWLv2, UD English GUMReddit, Open English WordNet, Wikidata main structured data, and local Tatoeba weekly English sentence/link exports. Share-alike UniMorph English, Wiktionary, DBnary, Wikipedia-derived raw text, OPUS, and blocked aggregate sources are excluded from this default composite.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Default English developer textpack for the currently generated English resource graph: core profile, normalization, segmentation, spelling/lexicon, lookup morphology, syntax annotation profiles, lexical-semantic WordNet KB resources, local Wikidata English core entity extract, search analyzer profile, local Tatoeba corpus rows, local Tatoeba parallel link rows, and generated quality evidence. It does not claim UniMorph paradigm-table coverage, Wiktionary/DBnary-derived lexical coverage, OPUS coverage, complete Wikidata dump coverage, parser models, neural models, raw web corpora, or hidden network access.
